statement: Between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-01, the Ukrainian Air Force command reports on at least seven separate overnight periods that Russia launched 100 or more one-way attack drones.
resolution: Daily Ukrainian Air Force air-defence tallies covering nights from 2026-08-19 to 2026-09-01 show 100 or more drones launched on seven or more of those nights, with at least one wire service reporting the same figures.
failure_condition: Fewer than seven of those fourteen nights carry a launch count of 100 or more drones.

statement: The United States conducts at least one military strike on Omani territory between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, and BBC report a US strike on Omani soil dated between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-31, or US Central Command confirms one.
failure_condition: No US munition impacts Omani territory within the stated window.

statement: Between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-30, either Russia or the United Kingdom expels at least one accredited diplomat of the other state.
resolution: The Russian foreign ministry or the UK Foreign Office announces the expulsion of at least one diplomat of the other state, dated 2026-08-19 to 2026-09-30, corroborated by two wire services.
failure_condition: Neither government orders a diplomatic expulsion of the other inside the window.

statement: ICE Brent front-month futures settle at or above 100.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: ICE published settlement prices for the front-month Brent contract show a close of 100.00 or higher on one or more trading days from 2026-08-19 through 2026-10-30.
failure_condition: Every front-month Brent settlement in the window prints below 100.00 dollars.

statement: The US Treasury daily par yield curve shows a 30-year rate at or above 5.50 percent on at least one business day between 2026-08-19 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Treasury daily par yield curve data, or FRED series DGS30, records a 30-year value of 5.50 or higher on one or more business days from 2026-08-19 through 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: The 30-year par yield stays below 5.50 percent on every business day in the window.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog carries at least eight entries with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
resolution: A fetch of the CISA KEV JSON feed returns eight or more entries whose dateAdded field falls between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: Seven or fewer KEV entries carry a dateAdded inside the window.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one entry whose vendorProject field is GitLab, with a dateAdded between 2026-08-19 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: A fetch of the CISA KEV JSON feed returns at least one entry with vendorProject GitLab and a dateAdded between 2026-08-19 and 2027-01-15 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry naming GitLab as vendorProject carries a dateAdded inside the window.

statement: A jury returns a verdict on the murder count against Duane Davis in Clark County, Nevada, between 2026-08-19 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: The Clark County Eighth Judicial District Court docket records a jury verdict on the murder count, entered between 2026-08-19 and 2026-11-30; a mistrial or continuance is not a verdict.
failure_condition: The docket carries no jury verdict on the murder count by 2026-11-30.

statement: In the Disney and ABC First Amendment suit against the FCC, the FCC files a motion to dismiss or an answer between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: The federal docket for the ABC or Disney suit against the FCC records a motion to dismiss or an answer filed by the FCC between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-15.
failure_condition: No FCC motion to dismiss or answer appears on that docket by 2026-10-15.

statement: The USGS earthquake catalog lists at least one magnitude 6.5 or greater event with an epicenter in Indonesia between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: A USGS FDSN event query for 2026-08-19 to 2026-09-30 returns one or more events of magnitude 6.5 or greater within the Indonesian region bounding box.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog shows no magnitude 6.5 or greater Indonesian event inside the window.
